description:
Foxiang 2 is a name for a numbered Yunnan tea cultivar, meaning Buddha fragrance. No published description of this line is known, so treat even its status as unconfirmed.

There is no solid record of its parents, leaf or cup, so don't trust a precise tasting note attached to it. Yunnan greens as a group are fuller and more assertive than the delicate greens of eastern China, and that is the most you can reasonably expect.

If you see it on a label, ask what the seller knows about the garden and the picking. Treat it as you would a good Yunnan green: water a little off the boil, short first steep, and drink it fresh.
history: No published record of Foxiang 2 is known: its breeder, parentage and release date are undocumented. Foxiang 3 is documented, but no link between the two should be assumed beyond the name.
